summary: CSR setup and resident copies occur before timing. Average-row-length dispatch can select any Width 2/4/8/16/32 specialization. Each group is assigned a row from the computed thread index, row<dim gates the CSR interval, lanes stride across all entries and reduce before lane zero stores. The event-timed host loop calls its selected function pointer once per runtime iteration; compiled main increments and compares that runtime count and branches back. Warmup dispatch is separate; final sm86 SASS contains every selectable width body through the store.
